outcome: A subscription cannot reference a plan that does not exist.

acceptance_criteria.text: Code can tell whether a subscription references a known plan.

expected_verification.assertion: a subscription naming a known plan is recognised as valid

acceptance_criteria.text: The constraint can be added to a subscriptions table that already holds rows, including rows whose plan has been removed.

expected_verification.assertion: the migration applies to a populated table with orphaned plan references

data_impact: Existing rows referencing removed plans must be resolved before the constraint holds.
rollout: Migration applied ahead of the application release.
rollback: Dropping the constraint restores the previous behaviour.
